minutes.headline: Open Space Committee deferred funding a title attorney for the Stump Cove parcel and appointed Anna to Economic Development.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed using donated funds to clear title on a parcel on Reservoir Road near Stump Cove for kayak access. Members preferred a firm estimate from the actual title attorney before committing money, so no motion was made. Anna was appointed to the economic development committee by roll call, and meetings were set for July 14 and August 11.

public_comment.topic: Dave asked why the other town-owned parcel with clear title and water access was set aside for kayak access, and suggested raising it if the Reservoir Road title work stalls.

votes.motion: Appoint Anna as the committee's representative to the economic development committee.
votes.outcome: passed (roll call: Brandon, Tanner and Anna each said hi; no dissent heard)

budget_items.topic: Donation fund for open space work
budget_items.what_was_said: The ad hoc committee has donated funds from an organization (heard as Bright Farms) available, proposed for clearing title on the Reservoir Road parcel.
Earlier title work on the Lake Shirley dam was voluminous and reportedly stopped at a set cost, done by a large Boston firm.
A rough estimate was mentioned; members noted it came from town counsel, not the attorney who would do the work.
The committee's pool is limited; members would not support spending it on a costly effort with a doubtful outcome.

decisions.decision: No motion to approve title funds was made; the chair and Paula will consult town counsel and return with a firm estimate from the title attorney.
Members asked that the title attorney's scope include recommendations for next steps if clear title cannot be proven.
Next meetings set for July 14 and August 11 at 7:30 by Zoom.
